attempts.summary: Configured node1 to log every sudo-executed command (with user and timestamp) to a dedicated /var/log/sudo-commands.log, separate from the general system log, by routing sudo's syslog facility (local2) to its own rsyslog destination with a stop rule. Verified the entries appear only in the new file (not in auth.log/syslog), performed the mandatory single-node restart, and confirmed the config and logging behavior persisted with a changed boot identity.
